standard_prerequisites.name: Preparation of a covering of a closed subscheme
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Same chapter, the companion result lifting a syntomic, smooth or etale covering of the closed subscheme to a covering of the ambient scheme with members factoring through it
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the covering with which the almost cocontinuity condition is satisfied.

core_obligations: State the condition to verify (proof lines 6917-6921): for a morphism V -> Y and a covering of the base change X x_Y V of the appropriate type, one must produce a covering of V of the same type each of whose base changes is either empty or factors through one of the given covering members.

Apply the companion result (proof lines 6921-6927): the required covering is obtained by applying the companion preparation result to the closed immersion X x_Y V -> V, which gives the almost cocontinuity in the three topologies.
proof_roadmap: Write out the almost cocontinuity condition for the base change functor.
Apply the companion preparation result for a closed immersion to obtain the required covering.
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that for a closed immersion the base change functor is almost cocontinuous between the big syntomic, smooth and etale sites (statement lines 6906-6915). The proof writes out the condition that almost cocontinuity requires (proof lines 6917-6921) and then satisfies it by applying the companion preparation result to the closed immersion obtained after base change (proof lines 6921-6927). The non-formal content is the recognition that the required refinement is exactly what the companion result supplies. The claim is H2: one condition restated and one companion input.
